scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with buildings on both sides, lined with parked motorcycles and trees. The street is paved with gray bricks and has a sidewalk made of the same material. The buildings have white marble facades with brown accents. A sign on the front of the building reads 'DRY MARTINI' in black letters. There are several windows on the upper floors of the building. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building on the left side of the street has a cream-colored facade with brown accents. It has three stories and a flat roof. The building on the right side of the street has a similar design but with a more ornate entranceway. The building on the far right has a large window on the first floor and two smaller ones on the second floor.
